validity.recommendation: Check the 20 bcm/y capacity. The wiki sources give 9.9 for the system after the 2021 expansion and 20 only as a planned level.
validity.researcher_notes: An Interfax report of 2021 quoting Gazprom says the whole system capacity rises by 4.4 to 9.9 billion cubic meters per year. A Neftegaz article of 2018 says further expansion would allow up to 20 billion cubic meters per year. The sheet holds 20 with a note citing a government document. The 20 may be a planned level and not today's capacity.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The Gazprom release of 21 December 2021 says the Komsomolsk to Khabarovsk section was finished and being filled with gas. The first parts of the system started in September 2011. Nothing in the wiki list reports a stoppage.
